twist1.title: Twist 1 — Federal funding pathway
lines: Primary: USDA Forest Service Community Wildfire Defense Grant (CWDG). It funds Community Wildfire Protection Plans (up to $250k) and their projects; we would join an eligible community or Fire Safe Council application as the planning-and-outreach tool.
Alternative: NSF SBIR/STTR (America’s Seed Fund), reauthorized through Sept 30, 2031; project pitches accepted anytime.
twist1.source: fs.usda.gov CWDG (next round not yet posted); sba.gov, Apr 13, 2026; seedfund.nsf.gov. Retrieved Oct 17, 2026.

twist2.title: Twist 2 — Going global (e.g., China)
lines: Carries over: NASA FIRMS fire detections, Sentinel-2 imagery, Copernicus GLO-30 elevation; ECMWF or GFS weather replaces US-only HRRR.
Needs local work: fuel maps (LANDFIRE is US-only), building footprints (OSM is sparse in many regions), agency zones, contact consent, local telephony rules.
twist2.source: NASA FIRMS; Copernicus; LANDFIRE; NOAA NCO; Herfort et al., Nature Comms 2023; docs.retellai.com. Retrieved Oct 17, 2026.
